newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Trading in China Travel Int'l suspended.
newsitem.headline: Trading in China Travel Int'l suspended.

text.p: Trading in the shares of red chip China Travel International was suspended on Monday morning, the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong said.
Trading in the shares of Sun Fook Kong Holdings Ltd was also suspending at the company's request pending an announcement, the exchange said.
Shares in the construction and civil engineering group rose sharply last week on speculation that China Travel would take a stake in the company.
The red-chip tourism-based conglomerate has been on an expansion trail, analysts said.

In March, China Travel announced it would take a 10 percent stake in Citybus Group Ltd and form a HK$100 million joint venture to develop land passenger transport services across the China-Hong Kong border and within China.
Sun Fook Kong closed at HK$1.50 on Friday and China Travel at HK$4.10.
China Travel is expected to announce its 1996 results later on Monday.
